narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Six squared plus two is thirty eight, so x squared plus two is always even.
<bookmark mark='three'/>Try x as three. Three squared is nine, and nine plus two is eleven.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Eleven is odd, so one good example does not prove always.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows 6² + 2 = 38, always even; then 3² + 2 = 11 appears below in the warning colour; the bubble is struck

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Take out a factor of two to prove always, or find one odd case to disprove it.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Is six m plus two q always even? Test x squared plus one with two and three.
